message.content:
Based on my search, here's what I found about free satellite radio options:

## SiriusXM Free Access (Ad-Supported)

SiriusXM now offers a **free, ad-supported tier** called **SiriusXM Free Access** for vehicles with SiriusXM 360L platform radios. This service includes:

- Around **two dozen free music streams** across genres (alternative rock, pop, hip hop, country)
- **Four sports channels**: ESPN Radio, Fox Sports, NBC Sports Audio, and Infinity Sports Network
- **News simulcasts**: CNN, MSNBC, Fox News Headlines
- **Two comedy channels**: Comedy Central Radio and Conan O'Brien Radio
- **Other channels**: NPR, PRX, The Catholic Channel, BYU Radio

**Important limitations:**
- Only available after a free trial expires
- Limited to **one vehicle** — cannot transfer to another radio
- **No streaming access** through SiriusXM apps
- You must use the service at least **once every 60 days** or it gets permanently cancelled

## Free Trial Offers

SiriusXM frequently offers **free trial periods** for new subscribers:
- Currently offering **4 months free** for app-only streaming (then $9.99/month)
- New car purchases often include **3-6 month free trials**

## Free-to-Air (FTA) Satellite Radio

For truly free satellite radio without subscriptions, there are **Free-to-Air (FTA)** satellite radio channels available in some regions:

- In **India**, you can receive **20+ satellite radio channels** using a DTH antenna, free-to-air set-top box, and LNB — no subscription needed
- These include radio channels in various regional languages
- Requires manual tuning or blind scan with FTA-only settings

## Important Distinction: HD Radio vs. Satellite Radio

**HD Radio** is a free alternative that offers improved digital broadcast quality over traditional AM/FM, but it's not satellite-based — it uses terrestrial digital signals.

## Streaming Alternatives

If you're looking for free audio entertainment, consider:
- **Spotify Free** (ad-supported streaming, not satellite)
- Other free streaming radio apps

True satellite radio (SiriusXM) generally requires a subscription, with the Free Access tier being the only ongoing free option — and it comes with significant limitations.

---

Sources:
1. https://thedesk.net/2024/08/siriusxm-free-access-ad-supported-tier/
2. https://www.bundle.app/en/sports/siriusxm-offer-how-to-get-first-four-months-of-satellite-radio-streaming-for-free-with-limited-time-deal-F2450A81-467C-4D5F-8272-04383D5ED769
3. https://www.sportingnews.com/us/tsn/news/siriusxm-offer-four-months-free-radio-streaming-deal/76d08dbad4551370029a18e3
4. https://www.freedish.in/2024/01/how-to-listen-to-satellite-radio-in.html
5. https://www.lemmymorgan.com/latest-fta-channels-and-frequencies/
6. https://www.usedcars.com/advice/tips/hd-radio-vs-satellite-radio-24
7. https://driving.ca/features/feature-story/beyond-radio-all-the-ways-to-get-satellite-streaming-music-and-more-in-your-car
8. https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/siriusxm-weighs-new-free-satellite-radio-service-frank-saxe?trk=pulse-article_more-articles_related-content-card
